free_text_notes.physician_note: 56-year-old man with type 2 diabetes, hypertension, admitted 5/19 for ORIF of right bimalleolar ankle fracture. Post-op day 6; working with PT twice daily.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Vitals stable this shift. Tolerating diet. The patient reads with glasses. All written discharge materials were provided in large print at the patient's request. The patient confirmed they could read and understand everything.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Met with patient and son to review the discharge plan. 5/25 19:00: Team decision tonight: metoprolol tartrate changed from 25 mg twice daily to 12.5 mg twice daily. Son called asking about the plan and does not know about the change; has not been able to reach the physician. Still waiting on pharmacy to finish the medication reconciliation. Original evening van slot cancelled; family will drive at the planned discharge time instead. Patient asked to move the orthopedic surgery clinic appointment; rebooked within 14 days of discharge.
